messages:
mira (AE): Quick sync — ZenBank wants a 10-day Dedicated POC. Must-haves: SAML SSO (Azure AD), SCIM provisioning from Okta with bulk import for ~35k users, RBAC mapping (nested groups), domain ownership for multiple banking domains, and answers to our security questionnaire. Can we get a presales pack before their kickoff Wed?

jon (Solutions Eng): Yep. Need IdP metadata XML, Okta SCIM base URL/token or CSV export, and expected concurrency/peak token rate. SCIM notes: POST /scim/v2/Bulk chunk <=2500, async job for >5k, default rate-limit 600/min per org, Retry-After on 429.

lee (SE): For RBAC ask them to provide CSV: group_path,role_name,permissions. We support nested paths. I'll add a sample CSV snippet. Also note: CSV bulk import uses staging S3 and needs 24-48h lead for >10k rows.

tara (Security): On questionnaire: we can share SOC2 Type II, pen-test summary (redacted), dataflow diagram, and a DPA excerpt for EU residency. If PHI/financial data with extra compliance is in scope, flag immediately. We don't expose HSM internals but can document KMS integration.

mira (AE): Domain verification — they asked if wildcard verification possible. What's our stance?

jon (Solutions Eng): We don't accept wildcard TXT by default. Options: per-subdomain DNS TXT or verify a delegated verification subdomain (verify.zenbank.com). DNS TXT is fastest for infra teams.

frank (Legal): Delegated subdomain approach looks fine; will prepare wording and require an attestation from their DNS owner. Wildcard verification exception needs legal sign-off.

lee (SE): Pricing: propose 2x-A10G equivalent Dedicated eval, 10 days, soft token cap and a one-time enablement fee for bulk import/engineer support. I'll draft the quote.

mira (AE): Action items: @jon one-page SAML+SCIM runbook + SCIM rate limits; @lee sample RBAC CSV + quote; @tara security pack + short answers doc; @frank domain verification wording. I'll bundle and send presales pack to ZenBank by EOD.

cal-bot: Meeting scheduled "ZenBank POC Kickoff"  2025-11-05 17:00 UTC. Invitees: mira (AE), jon (Solutions Eng), lee (SE), tara (Security), frank (Legal). Link: https://cal.example/evt/ZNK-POC

jon (Solutions Eng): Small runbook snippet to include:
```
SAML: provide IdP metadata XML + ACS URL
SCIM delta: PATCH /scim/v2/Users/{id} (use externalId)
Bulk: POST /scim/v2/Bulk (chunk <=2500); async job for >5k
Rate-Limit: 600/min per org; respect Retry-After on 429
CSV import: upload to staging bucket; allow 24-48h provisioning for large files
```

mira (AE): Thanks all — ping me if Okta bulk or domain verification becomes a hard blocker. :thumbsup:
